entities.summary: Arma (Arma-Pozo) is a poorly attested and extinct language of Colombia. Loukotka (1968) states that it was once spoken on the Pueblano River, but lists no source to substantiate this claim. Only one word of Arma-Pozo is known, being umecode: aoh is deprecated  'woman'.
